purpose: Migration evidence. Each AOT cmdlet port records every intentional behavior or architecture difference from its PowerShell source.

variances.sourceFeature: Cmdlet/ProcessBaseCommand lifecycle and WriteObject/WriteError contract
variances.targetDecision: AotCmdletBase plus AotExecutionContext and IPipelineRecord

variances.sourceFeature: Name, Id, InputObject, IncludeUserName, Module, FileVersionInfo and parameter sets
variances.targetDecision: Generated metadata drives Name, Id, InputObject, IncludeUserName, Module, and FileVersionInfo. InputObject has a typed internal adapter only; the source runner rejects general command-to-command pipeline binding.

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell WildcardPattern
variances.targetDecision: AOT adapter currently supports case-insensitive * and ? only

variances.sourceFeature: System.Diagnostics.Process and PSObject extended type data
variances.targetDecision: Typed AOT process, module, and file-version records expose the command data without PSObject extended type data

variances.sourceFeature: Module, FileVersionInfo, IncludeUserName, pipeline InputObject
variances.targetDecision: Module, FileVersionInfo, and IncludeUserName use IProcessCatalog. InputObject is a typed internal adapter; source-level command-to-command binding is deferred.

variances.sourceFeature: localized ProcessResources and ErrorRecord categories
variances.targetDecision: stable error IDs and plain messages in AotExecutionContext

variances.sourceFeature: TimeSpan/DateTime objects formatted by the PowerShell formatting system
variances.targetDecision: typed UptimeRecord with cmdlet-declared default Value column

variances.sourceFeature: InternalTestHooks plus terminating ErrorRecord when stopwatch timing is unavailable
variances.targetDecision: production Stopwatch.IsHighResolution check and ScriptException; the internal test hook is not carried over

variances.sourceFeature: PSHost.CurrentUICulture
variances.targetDecision: injectable IHostCulture whose local implementation reads CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture

variances.sourceFeature: full CultureInfo object and PowerShell formatter
variances.targetDecision: typed CultureRecord exposes Name, DisplayName, EnglishName, and LCID

variances.sourceFeature: culture lookup beyond invariant culture
variances.targetDecision: InvariantGlobalization=false; use platform ICU/globalization data while retaining Native AOT

variances.sourceFeature: PSHost.CurrentCulture and CultureInfo static APIs in cmdlet body
variances.targetDecision: injectable IHostCulture and ICultureCatalog services

variances.sourceFeature: Name ValueFromPipeline binding
variances.targetDecision: direct Name arguments only until the generic typed pipeline binder exists

variances.sourceFeature: ErrorRecord/localized messages and full CultureInfo object
variances.targetDecision: stable ItemNotFoundException error ID and typed CultureRecord columns

variances.sourceFeature: Verbs.FilterByVerbsAndGroups reflects over verb constants and VerbDescriptions loads .resx values through ResourceManager
variances.targetDecision: PwshAotPortGenerator reads Verbs.cs and VerbDescriptionStrings.resx at build time and emits 100 immutable GeneratedVerbInfo entries

variances.sourceFeature: System.Management.Automation.VerbInfo object and PowerShell formatter
variances.targetDecision: typed VerbRecord exposes Verb, AliasPrefix, Group, and Description columns

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell WildcardPattern supports character classes, ranges, and escaping
variances.targetDecision: shared SimpleWildcard applies case-insensitive * and ? only

variances.sourceFeature: Verb and Group have ValueFromPipeline and ValueFromPipelineByPropertyName
variances.targetDecision: direct arguments are implemented; generic cross-command pipeline binding remains deferred

variances.sourceFeature: TimeZoneInfo cache, local zone, system catalogue, and ID lookup in ProcessRecord
variances.targetDecision: injectable ITimeZoneCatalog wraps TimeZoneInfo.ClearCachedData, Local, GetSystemTimeZones, and FindSystemTimeZoneById

variances.sourceFeature: TimeZoneHelper uses PowerShell WildcardPattern over StandardName and DaylightName
variances.targetDecision: same two source fields and case-insensitive matching, using shared SimpleWildcard with * and ? only

variances.sourceFeature: Name has ValueFromPipeline=true
variances.targetDecision: direct Name arguments are implemented; generic scalar/record pipeline binding is deferred

variances.sourceFeature: full TimeZoneInfo object plus PowerShell ETS formatting
variances.targetDecision: typed TimeZoneRecord projects Id, names, UTC offset, and daylight-saving capability

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell host exposes operating-system time-zone identifiers
variances.targetDecision: delegate identifier availability to TimeZoneInfo; no hard-coded IANA/Windows mapping is claimed

variances.sourceFeature: SessionState.Path resolves PowerShell provider paths, provider wildcards, and literal paths
variances.targetDecision: IPhysicalFileResolver accepts direct physical files; Path supports deterministic terminal-name * and ? expansion and LiteralPath remains literal

variances.sourceFeature: InputStream parameter set and ProcessRecord/EndProcessing stream hashing
variances.targetDecision: InputStream is absent from the AOT descriptor until a typed stream and generic pipeline binding service exists

variances.sourceFeature: FileHashInfo output with PowerShell ETS formatting
variances.targetDecision: typed FileHashRecord projects Algorithm, Hash, and Path without PSObject or format-data dependencies

variances.sourceFeature: localized ErrorRecord construction for missing, unauthorized, and I/O file failures
variances.targetDecision: AotExecutionContext writes stable source-aligned IDs FileNotFound, UnauthorizedAccessError, and FileReadError with plain host messages

variances.sourceFeature: PSObject wrapping DateTime with ETS DisplayHint note property and PowerShell format data
variances.targetDecision: typed DateRecord carries DateTime plus Date/Time/DateTime display policy; the compact renderer uses round-trip value display

variances.sourceFeature: StringUtil composite formatting in fixed UFormat switch
variances.targetDecision: direct static BCL formatting and source-equivalent UFormat token mapping; FileDate aliases are explicit static mappings

variances.sourceFeature: Date ValueFromPipeline and ValueFromPipelineByPropertyName binding
variances.targetDecision: direct Date arguments are implemented; generic typed record/scalar pipeline binder is deferred and no input stage is silently accepted

variances.sourceFeature: empty or trailing-percent UFormat reaches source indexing failure
variances.targetDecision: stable ScriptException identifies the malformed format before evaluation

variances.sourceFeature: HelpSystem dynamically composes Alias, ScriptCommand, Command, Provider, Class, HelpFile, and DefaultHelp providers using session/module state
variances.targetDecision: Generate an immutable full-source HelpCatalog for every discovered cmdlet; it is independent from the smaller executable AOT command registry

variances.sourceFeature: MAML/HelpInfo topics, source command metadata, and runtime command discovery
variances.targetDecision: Every catalogued source cmdlet receives generated contract help and explicit AOT status, including commands without an AOT adapter

variances.sourceFeature: Module-path discovery imports/loads module code and delegates help to the runtime HelpSystem
variances.targetDecision: Scan declarative extensions/<module>/<version>/extension.json at query time with Native-AOT JSON source generation; metadata/help discovery never requires command registry membership or module assembly loading. help.json is an optional authored overlay rather than a discovery prerequisite.

variances.sourceFeature: runtime help-file/MAML lookup and updatable help content
variances.targetDecision: Optional extension help.json overlays manifest contracts. Missing, unreadable, malformed, or identity-invalid authored help falls back visibly to generated extension.json contract help; a malformed manifest or invalid provenance identity still rejects the package.

variances.sourceFeature: runtime culture-specific help-file discovery
variances.targetDecision: Generate selected cultures with exact-to-parent-to-en-US-to-contract fallback; begin with en-US rather than claim all installed PowerShell help cultures

variances.sourceFeature: -Online launches a browser and -ShowWindow uses the graphical host
variances.targetDecision: Core AOT help presents validated HTTP(S) HelpUri; browser/window behavior requires an explicit host policy and is not part of the headless core

variances.sourceFeature: provider, script, alias, class, DSC, external-script, and current-session help categories
variances.targetDecision: Initial scope supports generated Cmdlet category only; dynamic/provider/session categories are deferred behind a future explicit extension model

variances.sourceFeature: SessionState.InvokeCommand discovers live CommandInfo objects from imported modules, aliases, applications, functions, scripts, providers, and current-session state
variances.targetDecision: CompositeHelpCatalog merges the build-generated 290-cmdlet source catalog with declarative extension JSON; discovery never loads an extension module or consults only the executable adapter registry

variances.sourceFeature: Name, Module/PSSnapin, and CommandType query modes
variances.targetDecision: Support positional/-Name with case-insensitive SimpleWildcard, -Module including PSSnapin alias, and Cmdlet/Function CommandType filtering over typed CommandInfoRecord data

variances.sourceFeature: AliasInfo, ApplicationInfo, FunctionInfo, CmdletInfo, ExternalScriptInfo, FilterInfo, and PSObject outputs formatted by ETS
variances.targetDecision: Typed CommandInfoRecord exposes Name, CommandType, ModuleName, Version, Source, Availability, Status, and generated Syntax without PSObject or formatting data; Availability is a default column so discovery is not mistaken for executability

variances.sourceFeature: All, ArgumentList, ExcludeModule, FullyQualifiedModule, ListImported, Noun, ParameterName, ParameterType, ShowCommandInfo, Syntax, TotalCount, abbreviation/fuzzy matching, Verb, and non-Cmdlet/Function types
variances.targetDecision: Reject unsupported options/types at parse time; defer them until an explicit session and extension execution model exists

variances.sourceFeature: live ModuleInfo assembly/module identity
variances.targetDecision: Generated built-in contracts report PowerShell.BuiltIn; preserving original per-assembly module identity requires a source-generator path/assembly mapping input

variances.sourceFeature: PSModuleInfo, current-session loaded-module state, and $PSModulePath discovery
variances.targetDecision: CompositeModuleCatalog reports one logical generated PowerShell.BuiltIn module plus declarative extension.json packages, without importing a module, loading an assembly, or invoking a command

variances.sourceFeature: Name query over loaded, available, remote, CIM, and fully qualified module modes
variances.targetDecision: Support only positional/-Name using the shared case-insensitive * and ? matcher; reject All, ListAvailable, Refresh, FullyQualifiedName, PSSession, CimSession, PSEdition, and SkipEditionCheck until their safe source of truth exists

variances.sourceFeature: live PSModuleInfo objects with module implementation details and ETS formatting
variances.targetDecision: Typed ModuleInfoRecord exposes Name, Version, Origin, Availability, Status, Path, Trust, and Provenance sourced only from generated contracts and declarative package metadata

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShellGet/repository policy is separate from Get-Module and legacy import can execute arbitrary module initialization
variances.targetDecision: Show provenance but label every external package trust state unverified until a signed repository, hash, dependency, and install policy is designed; Get-Module itself never imports modules

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell module discovery has version selection, manifest identity, and error behavior tied to module paths and loaded session state
variances.targetDecision: One data-only ExtensionPackageCatalog validates extension schema v1, duplicate names, manifest/help/provenance identity correlation, and selects the highest dotted version (then lexical/path tie-breakers) for Get-Help/Get-Command while Get-Module inventories every valid installed version

ports.source: PowerShellGet/PSResourceGet package discovery; explicit PwshAotLite host control-plane contract rather than a generated src cmdlet

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell repository search is coupled to PowerShellGet/PSResourceGet repository protocol and package-management state
variances.targetDecision: Separate IRepositoryCatalog/RepositoryCatalog reads versioned declarative local repository-index JSON and projects typed advertised module data without joining installed extension discovery

variances.sourceFeature: Find-Module can query configured remote repositories and participates in a package-management workflow
variances.targetDecision: Find-Module itself has no HTTP client, credential lookup, package download, install, module import, DLL load, or script execution; a separate Install-Module local-file proof may consume a declared file URI only after explicit staging policy

variances.sourceFeature: Repository identity, package hashes/signatures, dependency resolution, prerelease policy, paging, and PSGallery/PSResourceGet protocol semantics
variances.targetDecision: Defer live repository transport and package-manager installation until an opt-in staged trust policy validates repository identity, signatures, dependencies, activation, and credentials outside read-only discovery; current local-file activation is intentionally narrower

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell package manager handles remote response parsing and repository policy
variances.targetDecision: Bound local index reads to 1 MiB/16 JSON levels and reject invalid schema, duplicate identities, controls, unsafe URI schemes/user-info, and unknown registration modes before materializing typed entries

ports.source: PowerShell completion, ArgumentCompleter, and Register-ArgumentCompleter subsystems

variances.sourceFeature: Tab completion resolves live SessionState commands, modules, parameters, aliases, help, providers, and extensibility hooks
variances.targetDecision: CompletionService projects CompositeHelpCatalog and CompositeModuleCatalog through explicit --complete and REPL complete endpoints; command/help suggestions visibly retain catalog availability

variances.sourceFeature: ValidateSet completion evaluates source cmdlet metadata and may use custom validation generators
variances.targetDecision: HelpParameter carries generated or manifest validation metadata; only direct literal ValidateSet values are suggested and source expressions/constants are never evaluated

variances.sourceFeature: ArgumentCompleter attributes, Register-ArgumentCompleter, script blocks, and module-defined completion can execute arbitrary code during discovery
variances.targetDecision: Do not import modules, load extension assemblies, invoke completers, or run script during completion; dynamic completion is deferred pending an explicit extension trust/execution policy

variances.sourceFeature: Provider/filesystem/value completion and PSReadLine terminal TAB integration
variances.targetDecision: Path/provider/value completion and terminal key handling are deferred; CompletionInput only lexes an incomplete line while UpstreamAstPipelineLowerer remains executable syntax authority

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell module/session command precedence and command resolution can choose an active command from a live runspace
variances.targetDecision: Get-Module retains all package versions, while module completion uses the same deterministic active package winner as help/command lookup; same-name active command contracts are never silently resolved: Get-Help/Get-Command retain every candidate and completion reports ambiguity without parameter completion

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell completion objects remain structured inside the host rather than a line-oriented external protocol
variances.targetDecision: The explicit completion endpoint uses TSV and escapes backslashes, tabs, line breaks, and other control characters from extension metadata before writing output

ports.source: PowerShellGet/PSResourceGet package installation; explicit PwshAotLite host control-plane contract rather than a generated src cmdlet

variances.sourceFeature: PowerShell package tooling integrates repository selection, transport, package extraction, dependency handling, module paths, and installation state
variances.targetDecision: Separate IModuleInstaller consumes IRepositoryCatalog records and is the sole current write boundary; Find-Module and all discovery catalogs stay read-only

variances.sourceFeature: Install-Module supports remote repositories and package-manager transports
variances.targetDecision: Accept only hostless credential-free file URIs whose directory is physically contained by explicit PWSH_AOT_PACKAGE_ROOTS, physically canonicalize configured roots so platform aliases remain valid, require an explicit PWSH_AOT_EXTENSIONS_ROOT write target, and reject symlinks below resolved trusted roots

variances.sourceFeature: Package tooling owns archive/package integrity and installation transactions
variances.targetDecision: Bound a local directory package by file count/size/path/link/regular-file policy, compare a declared SHA-256, stage in a fixed hidden same-volume directory that ExtensionPackageCatalog globally excludes from every configured recursive discovery root, rehash source and staged copies with fixed-time comparisons, verify the activation volume, validate staged manifest/help/provenance through ExtensionPackageCatalog, then atomically rename into activation; unequal existing content is a conflict and equal content is idempotent

variances.sourceFeature: Repository signatures, certificate/trust policy, credentials, dependencies, version ranges, uninstall/rollback, PSGallery/PSResourceGet transport, and legacy module execution
variances.targetDecision: Defer all remote transport and trust/package-manager semantics. Installation never imports a module, loads an assembly, runs script, or makes a registered legacy command executable
